Subject: Pipeline Definitions Reset — Practical Sprint & Office Hours

Team —

We need to align on the refreshed definitions for our forecast categories (Commit / Best Case / Pipeline) and get the open deals updated in the next two business cycles. This is not just a doc change — it changes how reps commit, how managers review, and how finance models next quarter.

Why this matters
- Recent forecasting variance analysis showed inconsistent usage of "Commit" (mixing in high-probability Best Case deals).
- We want predictable ARR recognition and a clearer signal for when to allocate reserved capacity for Dedicated deals.

What changed (high level)
- Commit: deals with signed commercial terms and all gating items cleared (legal SOW + security checklist satisfied OR explicit legal hold exception).
- Best Case: high-conviction opportunities with exec alignment and active procurement, but outstanding legal/PO obstacles.
- Pipeline: earlier-stage opportunities that are still in discovery or awaiting meaningful alignment.

Attached: playbook_deltas.pdf (two-page diff), training_exercises.xlsx (deal-by-deal practice set).

Practical sprint (required for quota-bearing reps and managers)
- When: Wed 12 May, 10:00–11:30 PT (hands-on)
- Where: Conference Room B + Zoom (link in Drive)
- Goals: update 3 deals each, walk through sample redlines, tag correct category in HubSpot filter we’ll provide.

Office hours (optional)
- Thurs 13 May, 14:00–15:00 PT — drop-in for edge cases and manager calibrations.

Prep ask (important)
- By EOD Tue 11 May: update the "Suggested Forecast Category" column in the attached spreadsheet for your active top-12 deals.
- Managers: review and add comments where you disagree; we will reconcile during the sprint.

If you think any accounts (e.g., enterprise negotiations with external procurement teams) need a separate handling policy, flag them — I’ve included Sarah Ng from Enterprise Co as she requested visibility into how we’ll signal "Commit" for multi-supplier procurements.

Thanks — looking forward to a focused sprint.

Best,

Thanks for the quick replies — a few clarifications and next steps: 

1) Recording: Yes — sprint will be recorded and uploaded to the Drive folder linked below for on-demand viewing.
2) Manager checklist: Laura — attaching a one-pager summary in the playbook_deltas.pdf (first page). It includes a 5-point verification checklist + escalation contacts.
3) ARR buckets: Marissa — good call. I added tabs in training_exercises.xlsx for the three buckets and included sample gating language for each.
4) Legal holds: new rule — if there is an active legal hold that prevents signature AND there is no explicit procurement/finance exception signed, treat as Best Case. If legal has approved an exception in writing (email from Legal PM), then it can be considered Commit.
